references.text: Ezekiel describes the Lord's judgment over the nations, which resembles the scene in Matthew 25:31 where Jesus comes in his glory to judge.
Daniel sees a vision of the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven, a scene that recalls the description of Jesus' return in Matthew 25:31.
Jesus speaks of his return in glory to reward each person, which parallels the judgment scene in Matthew 25:31.
Hebrews speaks of Christ who will come again, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him, which can be seen in light of the judgment and salvation in Matthew 25:31.
Revelation describes the white throne and the judgment, which has similarities with Jesus' return and the judgment in Matthew 25:31.
